q1_issues.issue: The appositive's of-phrase is attached to the person as (Possession john_d_rockefeller_iv west_virginia), asserting a Rockefeller/West-Virginia relation where the text relates West Virginia to the "Democrat" role he fills.
(PartOf sk_provision_1 sk_bill_1) is emitted outside the seal, but the sealing rule projects only a definite referent's Member / Name typing atom, not the relational atoms of its description.

q2_gaps: an appositive NP carrying its own PP complement ("Democrat of West Virginia") — the appositive yields only a typing atom, so there is no witness for the complement to attach to

a proper-noun modifier inside a common-noun compound ("the Senate bill") — Compound concepts fuses it as senate_bill, while Names and casing would read the capitalized run as the name and the adjacent lowercase noun as its kind, which gives the wrong result here
notes: The courtesy title stays in the Name string with the symbol derived from the name alone, the appositive typing takes the host clause's Past wrapper, and the non-factive seal is clean — the definite provision/bill/Medicare project while the indefinite "a basic tenet" and its "basic" property stay inside.
